shortDescription: Commander, we are at the gates of the Forbidden City. The Redfield Renegades are hitting the main lines along with my troops. I need you and Captain Holzmann to break one of the outer fire support locations to open a path for Beta combat Command of the Thirty-Third Hussars. You have to defeat the defenders so we can take control of the facility and turn its guns on Warrior House LuSaan.
longDescription: Tight terrain and artillery. I suggest fast, jump-capable 'Mechs commander, you'll need them.

objectiveList.title: Hold the Firebase until Captain Holzmann makes landfall

missionSuccessStatementOverride: You were instrumental in our successes, Commander, well done.
badFaithStatementOverride: We took severe losses due to you not carrying out your mission.
goodFaithStatementOverride: You made the effort, Commander, but my Hussars paid the price for your lack of ability.
